name: identity
operational_definition: Return input grid unchanged; exact equality required on all demos.
documented_limit: No inference beyond identity; selected first if earlier than any other exact fit.

name: reflect_horizontal
operational_definition: Reverse cell order within each row; whole-grid left-right mirror.
documented_limit: Whole grid only; no object selection or conditional axis detection.

name: reflect_vertical
operational_definition: Reverse row order; whole-grid top-bottom mirror.
documented_limit: Whole grid only; no object selection or conditional axis detection.

name: rotate_90
operational_definition: Rotate whole grid 90 degrees clockwise.
documented_limit: No object-specific rotation; output dimensions follow transform.

name: rotate_180
operational_definition: Apply internal clockwise 90-degree rotation twice; exposed as one candidate.
documented_limit: No searchable composition tree; this fixed transform is atomic in candidate inventory.

name: rotate_270
operational_definition: Apply internal clockwise 90-degree rotation three times; exposed as one candidate.
documented_limit: No searchable composition tree; this fixed transform is atomic in candidate inventory.

name: transpose
operational_definition: Transpose rows and columns across the main diagonal.
documented_limit: Whole-grid transform; no relation extraction or object-wise transpose.

name: anti_transpose
operational_definition: Reflect/transpose across the anti-diagonal using fixed grid index mapping.
documented_limit: Whole-grid transform; no object-wise relation or conditional geometry.

name: translate_constant
operational_definition: Infer one common row/column offset from demonstrations; shift whole grid without wrap; fill with modal source color.
documented_limit: Heuristic anchor search caps source anchors at 16; assumes common translation; clipping/fill semantics are restrictive; no separate object displacement.

name: recolor_bijection
operational_definition: Infer a global one-to-one mapping from every source color to one target color; apply to all cells.
documented_limit: No many-to-one merge, conditional/object-specific recoloring, or combined geometry+recolor program.

name: rectangular_integer_grid
operational_definition: Grid is a nonempty rectangular matrix of integer cells; ARC source preflight separately checked expected color range.
documented_limit: Grid class itself does not validate color range; schema check is not a solution operator.

name: mean_normalized_dimensions
operational_definition: Mean over demonstrations of (height+width)/60 for nearest-episode distance.
documented_limit: Auxiliary retrieval feature only; not a transformation or shape reasoning program.

name: mean_color_count
operational_definition: Mean number of distinct input colors divided by 10 over demonstrations.
documented_limit: Auxiliary retrieval feature only; no color-role or object-specific semantics.

name: mean_4connected_component_count
operational_definition: Mean of count_objects over demonstration inputs; count_objects counts 4-connected non-background components, treating all nonzero colors as connected regardless of color boundaries.
documented_limit: Not object segmentation for the candidate solver; background defaults to 0 and components can merge adjacent colors.

name: mean_nonzero_density
operational_definition: Mean fraction of nonzero input cells over demonstrations.
documented_limit: Auxiliary scalar; no object/pattern reasoning.

name: mean_train_pair_change_ratio
operational_definition: Mean per-demonstration changed-cell ratio; mismatched dimensions count as changed.
documented_limit: Uses provided training outputs for retrieval distance only; not an output program.

name: first_demo_structural_bucket
operational_definition: First demonstration is bucketed by same/changed shape, same/changed palette, and same/changed 4-connected non-background component count.
documented_limit: Descriptive bucket, not semantic task family or searchable rule.

name: mirror_symmetry_property
operational_definition: Boolean if any train input/output is mirror-symmetric left-right or top-bottom.
documented_limit: Diagnostic property only; not evidence the task rule is symmetry and not used as a candidate program.

name: count_objects
operational_definition: Count 4-connected non-background cell components; background defaults to color 0.
documented_limit: Imported by 13G for retrieval/structural features; not in the 10-program candidate set.

name: group_by_color
operational_definition: Return per-nonbackground-color cell counts as a mapping.
documented_limit: Generic grid helper exists but Phase13G does not call or enumerate it as an ARC solution program.

name: validate_grid_schema
operational_definition: Trace step is emitted by trace_for; runner sets trace_schema_valid=True literally. Data preflight checked rectangularity/color range separately.
documented_limit: No independent runtime validator call in discovery path; trace-valid metric bit is not computed per record.

name: enumerate_candidate_programs
operational_definition: Enumerate fixed ordered PROGRAMS and stop according to supplied budget/first demo fit.
documented_limit: Budget differs by entry point; no full candidate-fit set retained.

name: apply_program
operational_definition: Apply one atomic candidate to whole grid with inferred context where needed.
documented_limit: No arbitrary program composition or object-level action graph.

name: verify_demonstrations
operational_definition: Replay candidate against every supplied training pair and require exact equality.
documented_limit: Coverage measure is exact-demo fit, not test accuracy; historical solve_task also computes test output immediately after fit.
